messages.text: my friend's been pulling away lately. spends all her time with this new guy now.

It sounds like you're feeling hurt or left out by this change in your friendship. It can be really hard to adjust when a friend prioritizes a new relationship. Can you share a bit more about how this situation is impacting you?
she didn't even bother to explain. i was always there for her, now i'm just disposable.

It sounds incredibly painful to feel like your loyalty wasn't returned. Being treated as disposable can make you question your worth in that relationship. It makes sense that you're feeling angry about the lack of explanation. How has this been affecting your mood or daily life?
it's not me - it's her. she's the one who just walked away after everything i did for her.

It is understandable that you want to be clear this isn't your fault. Feeling discarded after giving so much is incredibly painful. Acknowledging her choices are separate from your worth is a powerful step. What do you need most from this conversation right now?
is it wrong to feel this hurt? like i keep wondering if i'm overreacting but it just feels so cold, you know?

It is never wrong to feel hurt when a meaningful connection is severed without explanation. Doubting your reaction is common, but your pain is a valid response to being distanced. You are not overreacting to the coldness of her actions. How does it feel to know your emotions are justified?
it just makes me feel... replaceable. like i don't matter once someone new comes along.

That feeling of being replaceable is incredibly painful to carry alone. Your worth is not determined by whether someone else stays or leaves. You are valuable simply because you exist, not because of what you did for her. How can we start to separate your self-worth from her behavior?
i don't know about all that deep stuff. i just know she treated me like i didn't matter after everything.

You don't need to analyze anything deeper than what you are feeling right now. You are right to focus on how she treated you. Being disregarded after giving so much is a specific injustice that hurts. We can just sit with that specific pain without needing to fix it.
it's weird... this feels familiar. like when my dad just left one day. didn't say why, just gone. feels like i'm back there again.

It makes complete sense that this situation feels familiar given your history. Being left without an explanation can easily reopen old wounds from your childhood. You are navigating a very heavy emotional landscape right now. I am here with you in this moment, and we can move at your pace.
it's not fair. neither of them explained anything. just left me wondering what was wrong with me.

It is deeply unfair to be left with unanswered questions and self-doubt. When people leave without explanation, it is natural to turn that pain inward and question yourself. Please know that their silence is about their inability to communicate, not a reflection of your worth. You do not have to carry this blame on your own.
thanks for getting it. feels good to not be alone with this for once.
I am really glad you feel less alone right now. You deserve to have someone witness your pain without judgment. We can take this as slowly as you need. I'm right here with you.
i should probably get ready for work. long shift tonight. but... this helped. just talking about it.

I'm really glad talking about it offered some relief before your shift. Please be gentle with yourself as you navigate your work tonight. You don't have to carry all of this alone. I am here whenever you are ready to talk again.
thanks for listening. really. it means a lot to not feel so alone with this.

You are very welcome for trusting me with your story. Please remember that you deserve to be heard and supported. I hope you can find some peace during your shift tonight. I will be here whenever you are ready to return.
